questions.question: When can the princess be found, according to the legend?
questions.explanation: The legend says it can only be done on St. John's Eve.

questions.question: How many ducats does Lutek receive from the princess?
questions.explanation: The princess gives him a purse with a hundred ducats.

questions.question: What does Lutek finally spend the money on?
answers: He gives it to a hungry old man
He hides it under the floor
questions.explanation: He pours the remaining ducats into the hands of the old invalid.

questions.question: What does Lutek become at the end of the story?
answers: A shoemaking master with his own workshop
questions.explanation: Soon Lutek becomes a master and opens his own workshop.

questions.question: Where is the legend of the duck located?
answers: In the cellars of the Ostrogski Castle on Tamka Street
questions.explanation: The shoemakers talk about the cellars of the Ostrogski Castle on Tamka Street.
